private_ipc.linux_endpoint: inherited same-EUID Unix stream; separate from VPN stdin/stdout
private_ipc.public_client_authorization: Separate Linux UID/device-bound host admission; never expose the inherited lane to the GUI

linux_public_ipc.peer_authorization: SO_PEERCRED UID; root-owned parent; client verifies root peer
linux_public_ipc.device_binding: Validated active readiness device must match the computer reference and API public-identity hash
linux_public_ipc.mailbox: One CLOEXEC AF_UNIX stream passed with SCM_RIGHTS; bounded duplex forwarding to native chat-mailbox
linux_public_ipc.cancellation: Disconnect, binding retirement, service stop, deadline or caller cancellation close chat-owned resources only

ownership: Existing exit only with matching validated profile; otherwise separate authenticated service-only session; VPN reservation drains previous service-only work before publication
fresh_service_profile: P0 default, matching accepted native chat acquisition; never a P1 entitlement grant
desktop_adaptations: Portable net.Conn replaces Android JNI/socketpair; shared transport/crypto/owner remain unchanged
Java authorization/conflict classification is applied before reading an error body
Header memory is also bounded to16384 bytes
HTTP operation cancellation is separate from transport socket teardown so TLS denial is not reclassified
Deadline callbacks are fenced against replaced timers; cancellation never closes a borrowed VPN

integration.shared_go_adapter: implemented; native VPN worker owns the shared coordinator and publishes/drains its validated session
integration.linux_service_ipc: UID/device-bound user-service admission and ChatOwner existing-exit API/mailbox routing implemented; local socket/proof/lifecycle checks only
integration.system_route_mailbox: Existing OS-routing path retained as SYSTEM, not advertised as protected-underlying DIRECT
integration.native_delivery: Linux host passes existing-exit traffic through the native private lane; Windows endpoint and Linux service-only orchestration remain NOT_INTEGRATED. Prior binaries do not support this endpoint
